messages:
Ana: Quick idea — run a microexperiment linking a 3-step Quickstart template + 30-min live micro-workshop. Hypothesis: microcredits + a tiny workshop will boost 7-day activation by improving first successful request rate. :seedling:
Jess: Love it. Two questions: how do we track ‘first successful request’ reliably? and what counts as workshop attendance?
Ana: Tracking: require a valid API call that returns tokens > 0 and a success flag in our backend. Workshop = joined Zoom + submitted one prompt from template. We’ll instrument with ?utm_source=seedflow&utm_experiment=quickstart_nudge in the workshop link.
Omar: Instrumentation note — need an event in analytics for `quickstart_template_used` and one for `workshop_submitted_prompt`. Also add a fallback when webhook fails.
Mike: Creative idea — two arms: A) template-first email + microcredit (1k tokens) B) demo-first invite to 30-min workshop + microcredit after attendance. Measure activation and retention.
Jess: Concern: spammy if we mail everyone. Suggest limit to 2k new signups from last 30 days with >1 sign-in but no successful call. That’s our target cohort.
Ana: Agreed. Also propose a lightweight landing with two CTAs, split by variant. We can reuse existing prompt templates but surface them differently.
Mike: Copy sketch for template-first: "Try our Quickstart pack — 1k microcredits to test 3 curated prompts. No card required. Start now." For workshop-first: "Join a 30-min lab — build your first app with our team, earn 1k microcredits after you ship a prompt."
Jess: Love the copy. Can we A/B test subject lines too? e.g., "Your 1k microcredits — try this playbook" vs "Ship an app in 30 minutes (microcredits included)"
Omar: Ops checklist: set up cohort filter in Growth DB, add events to ingestion pipeline, wire the reward grant service to only issue after `workshop_submitted_prompt` OR `quickstart_template_used`. Add feature flag for rollout.
Ana: Timeline proposal: week 0 — instrumentation + landing; week 1 — creative + emails; week 2 — launch 2-week experiment. Jess/Mike, can you own creative and copy? Omar to own events/flags.
Jess: I can take creative. Will drop hero visuals + 3 prompt thumbnails by Thu.
Mike: I’ll draft email sequences and the two subject-line variations.
Omar: I’ll add the events and feature flag today, will ping here when deployed.
growth-bot: event `quickstart_template_used` created in staging at 5376543275.
Ana: Perfect — thanks. Quick ask: keep messaging gentle — offer help not pressure. Aim for a 15% lift in first-successful-call. If we hit that, we scale.
Jess: Noted. Will keep tone helpful. :slightly_smiling_face: 
Mike: Adding tracking checklist to the rollout doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/seedflow-quickstart (placeholder).
Ana: Cool — updating the experiment brief and tagging in the product metrics board. Will follow up with a short demo of the landing tomorrow.
Omar: One more — add a small NPS pulse for workshop attendees to surface friction.
Ana: Good call. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
